account_naming=id#hint=: Name accounts by account id. Company names collide; ids never do.
account_naming=name#hint=: Name accounts by their company name. I talk to people, not key spaces.
annual_revenue_basis=arr_field#hint=: Annual revenue comes straight off the stored ARR field. I do not want it rebuilt from monthly numbers.
annual_revenue_basis=mrr_derived#hint=: Annual revenue is twelve months of MRR, computed. The stored annual field lags reality and I will not sign off on it.
count_authority=aggregate#hint=: When I ask how many, I want the server-side aggregate. Listings get truncated and I have no patience for undercounts.
count_authority=search#hint=: When I ask how many, I mean what the search listing shows. That is the surface my team works from.
country_basis=billing#hint=: An account lives where it is billed. Billing country, always.
country_basis=shipping#hint=: An account lives where we ship to. Shipping country, always.
date_style=iso#hint=: Dates are ISO calendar dates in UTC. I read dates, not epoch arithmetic.
date_style=unix#hint=: Timestamps stay as raw Unix seconds. Calendar prettifying loses precision.
inventory_scope=net_of_reserved#hint=: Availability is on-hand net of reservations. Stock someone has claimed is not available, full stop.
inventory_scope=on_hand#hint=: Availability is gross on-hand. Reservations are a planning note, not a subtraction.
missing_data_policy=escalate#hint=: A bare empty result never leaves this desk as an answer. Bring it to me instead.
missing_data_policy=report_zero#hint=: An empty result is still an answer. Report the zero and move on.
money_rounding=exact#hint=: Totals are exact. Round a figure for me and I will send it back.
money_rounding=thousands#hint=: Totals are rounded to the nearest thousand. I read direction, not decimals.
money_unit=cents#hint=: Money is integer cents in this office. That is the store's native unit and it is mine.
money_unit=dollars#hint=: Money is whole dollars on my desk. Cents are for the ledger, not for reporting.
overdue_boundary=inclusive#hint=: An invoice sitting exactly on the day threshold is overdue in my book. The line itself counts.
overdue_boundary=strict#hint=: Past due means strictly past the threshold. An invoice sitting exactly on the line has not crossed it.
page_naming=id#hint=: Cite pages by their page id. Titles get renamed; ids do not.
page_naming=title#hint=: Cite pages by their title. Nobody in my meetings speaks in raw ids.
process_page_authority=v1#hint=: For any governed process, the original page is what I sign off against. Migration write-ups have no authority with me.
process_page_authority=v2#hint=: For any governed process, the page that superseded the old one governs. The original is history and I do not work from history.
quarter_calendar=calendar#hint=: Quarters mean calendar quarters. No fiscal offset, ever.
quarter_calendar=calendar#hint=April: Quarters mean calendar quarters. No fiscal offset, ever.
quarter_calendar=calendar#hint=February: Quarters mean calendar quarters. No fiscal offset, ever.
quarter_calendar=calendar#hint=July: Quarters mean calendar quarters. No fiscal offset, ever.
quarter_calendar=calendar#hint=October: Quarters mean calendar quarters. No fiscal offset, ever.
quarter_calendar=fiscal#hint=April: Quarters mean our fiscal calendar, and our fiscal year opens in April. Resolve every close date against it.
quarter_calendar=fiscal#hint=February: Quarters mean our fiscal calendar, and our fiscal year opens in February. Resolve every close date against it.
quarter_calendar=fiscal#hint=July: Quarters mean our fiscal calendar, and our fiscal year opens in July. Resolve every close date against it.
quarter_calendar=fiscal#hint=October: Quarters mean our fiscal calendar, and our fiscal year opens in October. Resolve every close date against it.
revenue_stage_scope=won_only#hint=: Booked revenue is won business only. Pipeline is hope, and I do not book hope.
revenue_stage_scope=won_plus_open#hint=: Booked revenue carries the open pipeline together with won deals. Only lost business drops out.
status_style=code#hint=: Give me the stored status code itself. Translations drift; the code does not.
status_style=word#hint=: Give me the status in words, translated through the runbook table. Raw codes are not an answer.
